Yes, there are May intake universities in UK for 2027, but the choice is much smaller than in September or January. For international students, most May entry is course-specific and postgraduate-led, especially in business, computing, data, cyber security, management and professional programmes. A smaller number of bachelor, top-up and pathway routes also start in May.

The short answer is: Coventry has multiple courses with a confirmed May 2027 start, UEL has announced its May 2027 intake, and London Met and Wolverhampton publish confirmed May 2027 pathway starts. Northumbria University London and Ulster branch campuses also show substantial May-start provision for the 2026/27 cycle.

Here’s the thing: a university can offer a May intake without offering your course in May. Check the course, campus, start date and fee before you pay a deposit.

Last checked: 18 August 2026. Some universities are still releasing final course details for this intake.

Quick Answer: May Intake in UK 2027

Question

Answer

Is May intake available in UK universities?

Yes, at selected universities and courses.

Strongest study level

Postgraduate, particularly MSc and business-related courses.

Are undergraduate options available?

Yes, but they are limited and often include top-up or pathway routes.

When should you apply?

Start preparing in autumn 2026 and apply as soon as your course opens.

Typical fee examples in this guide

Roughly £12,500 to £21,500, depending on programme and level.

Main risk

Choosing a university name without checking the exact May-start course.

If you are still comparing destinations and study routes, start with your wider UK study plan before narrowing the shortlist.

Course-specific

The status labels above deliberately distinguish confirmed May 2027 course or pathway information from recurring May provision. Northumbria currently lists May across many 2026/27 courses, Ulster's branch-campus finder shows 32 courses with May as a filter, and Teesside University London confirms a 17 May 2027 postgraduate start date.

Coventry provides the clearest course-level evidence. Its Advanced Software Engineering MSc lists May 2027 and an international tuition fee of £19,500.

UEL is different. It says its May 2027 intake will open later in 2026 and currently shows May 2026 courses as an indication. Its academic calendar already places Welcome Week on 24 to 28 May 2027, with teaching from 1 June 2027.

That distinction matters. A verified shortlist beats a long list built from old intake pages.

Which UK Universities With May Intake Can International Students Consider?

For international students, May is strongest when a course already runs several intakes a year. Coventry and Northumbria London are good examples in computing and business. Ulster branch campuses show May entry across undergraduate, pre-master's and postgraduate routes, while UEL has a broad recent May portfolio.

A practical example helps. A graduate looking for MSc Cyber Security can currently see May among the Northumbria London start dates. A student looking for a conventional three-year bachelor course will find far fewer choices.

That is one of the mildly surprising features of May intake in UK universities: the postgraduate market can look healthy while undergraduate choice remains quite narrow.

If you need broader help with documents, admission steps or course selection, use the support available for overseas applicants without creating a separate May-intake article for every nationality.

May Intake UK 2027 Deadline and Application Timeline

There is no single national deadline for May intake in UK, so international students need to follow the exact university timetable. Each institution sets its own application deadlines, deposit requirements, and enrolment timelines, and some deadlines may not be published yet.

Use this as a safe planning sequence:

Period

What to do

Shortlist courses, compare universities, and check official course pages

December 2026 to January 2027

Apply to universities where the May application window is available

February to March 2027

Travel and enrol according to the university calendar

Do not treat January as a universal closing date. The safer approach is to apply according to your chosen university and course timeline rather than relying on a general intake deadline.

If May becomes too tight, compare January entry with the main autumn admission cycle.

Best Courses in UK With May Intake

The strongest May course cluster is postgraduate. Current official pages repeatedly show computing, business, management and technology subjects.

Common options include MSc Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Data Science, Big Data, Cyber Security, International Business and Business Analytics. Digital Marketing, International Project Management, Marketing and Public Health also appear across current May course portfolios.

Northumbria University London lists May among the start dates for multiple 2026/27 MSc programmes, with many international fees at £21,500. Ulster branch campuses also show May starts across Computer Science and Technology, International Business, Marketing and Health Promotion and Public Health.

May Intake in UK for Masters

For students targeting May intake in UK for Masters, postgraduate programmes offer the widest choice within this admission window.

Coventry is particularly useful because its current 2026/27 pages show May 2027 across several postgraduate areas, while Northumbria London and Ulster publish substantial recurring May provision.

If management is your target, compare those options with wider UK MBA routes. Choose the course first, then the intake.

Undergraduate May Intake Options in UK

Undergraduate May intake options in UK are more limited for international students, but they do exist.

Ulster branch campuses currently show May for BSc (Hons) Global Business and BSc (Hons) Computing Systems.

Northumbria University London also publishes selected May-start undergraduate and top-up provision. Pathways create another route: Wolverhampton's International Foundation Programme has an explicit May 2027 start and costs £17,600.

A top-up, foundation programme and standard Year 1 bachelor entry are not the same route. Check progression rules before you compare fees.

May Intake Universities in London

Students searching for May intake universities in London have several practical options.

Northumbria University London offers May starts across a range of postgraduate business and technology courses. London Met has a confirmed May 2027 Pre-Master's option. Ulster branch campuses list selected May courses in London, while Coventry also publishes May 2027 postgraduate options through its London provision.

London gives students access to a wider range of academic opportunities, universities, and career-focused courses.

May Intake UK Fees and Scholarships

For international students, May intake UK fees do not follow a separate national price. Tuition depends on the course, institution and study level.

These examples put a realistic planning range around £12,500 to £21,500 for the routes shown here. They do not represent every May course in the UK.

If price is your main filter, compare lower-cost postgraduate routes instead of assuming May is cheaper.

Scholarships can reduce the figure. Wolverhampton advertises awards of up to £5,000 for its May 2027 International Foundation Programme. London Met's one-term Pre-Master's advertises scholarships up to £2,500, followed by a £5,000 Bright Futures Scholarship for eligible students who successfully progress to a postgraduate degree.

Entry Requirements and English Tests

Entry standards remain course-specific. Universities commonly ask for academic qualifications, transcripts, a passport and English-language evidence. Some postgraduate programmes also ask for references, a CV or personal statement.

Coventry's Advanced Software Engineering MSc, for example, lists IELTS 6.5 overall with no component below 5.5. Wolverhampton's May foundation route lists IELTS 5.5 overall with no component below 5.5.

That is why checking an exact course page beats relying on a generic university requirements table.

Can You Get May Entry Without IELTS?

Students often search for May intake without IELTS, but there is no blanket IELTS exemption.

A university may accept another approved test or other evidence depending on the course and applicant. Check alternative ways to meet English requirements, current PTE acceptance and whether previous English-medium study may be considered.

The exact course requirement remains the final check.

How to Apply for May Intake in UK

To apply for May intake in UK, start with the course page, not a general university list.

  1. Confirm the course, university and campus.
  2. Read the academic and English language requirements.
  3. Prepare your documents and submit the application.
  4. Meet any offer conditions and complete the university enrolment process.
  5. Complete all required university checks and prepare for your study journey in the UK.

One delayed document can push every later step back.

I have seen this pattern repeatedly in real application planning: the student with a ready transcript, English result and clear academic plan is often in a stronger May-intake position than the student carrying a much longer university shortlist.

So do the important tasks early.

Does May Intake Affect the Graduate Route?

No. The May intake itself does not shorten the Graduate Route.

Under the current rules, eligible non-doctoral graduates who apply on or after 1 January 2027 receive 18 months. PhD and other doctoral graduates receive three years.

A May 2027 starter should therefore plan around the 18-month rule rather than older two-year wording.

May is useful because it can prevent an unnecessary wait. It is not automatically easier, cheaper or better.

Think about it this way: starting four months earlier has little value if you choose a weaker course just to make the intake.

FAQs About May Intake in UK 2027

Which universities offer May intake in UK for 2027?

Current confirmed or announced examples include Coventry University, UEL, London Metropolitan University Study Centre and Wolverhampton International Study Centre. Northumbria University London and Ulster branch campuses also publish substantial May-start provision, while Teesside University London confirms a May 2027 academic start.

Is May intake available in UK universities in 2027?

Yes. Selected universities and courses already show May 2027 dates, while some institutions are still releasing their final course lists.

What is the deadline for May intake UK 2027?

There is no single UK-wide deadline for the May intake. Each university and course sets its own application timeline, so students should start preparing from autumn 2026 and apply as soon as their chosen course opens. Allow enough time for application review, offer conditions, tuition arrangements, and university enrolment steps.

How much does May intake in UK cost?

Verified examples in this guide range from £12,500 for London Met's one-term Pre-Master's to £21,500 for many current Northumbria London MSc routes.

Are there affordable UK universities with May intake?

Are bachelor courses available in the May intake?

Yes, but options are limited. Current examples include selected Ulster undergraduate courses and May 2027 foundation or pathway provision at institutions such as Wolverhampton.

Are May and June Intake UK Universities the Same?

Not always. An intake may carry a May label even when teaching starts in June. UEL, for example, has May 2027 Welcome Week from 24 to 28 May, followed by teaching from 1 June.
